import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# Define the DiscountFinder class
class DiscountFinder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.retailers = {
            'amazon': 'https://www.amazon.com',
            'walmart': 'https://www.walmart.com'

        products = soup.find_all('product')
